title: feat(dashboard): retire in-page Edit; Studio icon deep-links to the dashboard design page
body:
## What & why

Dashboard authoring moves entirely into Studio, and the top-bar "Design in Studio" icon becomes context-aware so it opens the *current* dashboard's design page.

- The in-page dashboard **Edit** button + inline `DashboardConfigPanel` are removed — `DashboardView` is now a pure viewer. Authoring lives in one place: Studio's Interfaces pillar.
- The top bar's **Design in Studio** icon deep-links, on a dashboard route, straight to that dashboard's design page (`/studio/:packageId/interfaces?surface=dashboard:<name>`) via the existing `?surface=` restore mechanism; it falls back to the package's Data tab elsewhere.

## Scope note — the "US$" currency report is handled separately (server-side)

The original report ("KPI shows `US$…` although nothing named a currency") was traced end-to-end against the live HotCRM executive dashboard. That KPI is a **dataset** measure, not an object aggregate: the backend's `/api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` stamps `currency: "USD"` on the `total_amount` measure because HotCRM's `amount` field is `Field.currency()` with **no code of its own**, so it inherits the **workspace default currency**, which the platform defaults to `USD` (ADR-0053 localization). `DatasetWidget` then renders it faithfully. This never goes through `ObjectMetricWidget`, so an earlier client-side currency tweak here didn't fix it and only made object-bound KPIs inconsistent with dataset KPIs / field cells — it has been **reverted** in this PR. The currency default is being addressed at the platform layer (framework localization) in a separate change.

## Changes

- `app-shell/utils/appRoute.ts` — new `appStudioSurfacePath()` helper building the Interfaces-pillar deep-link (+ shared `studioPackageId` guard); exported from the utils barrel.
- `app-shell/layout/AppHeader.tsx` — the "Design in Studio" icon deep-links to the dashboard surface on a `dashboard` route, else the Data tab.
- `app-shell/views/DashboardView.tsx` — reduced to a pure viewer (removed Edit button, add-widget toolbar, inline config panel wiring, save/draft plumbing).
- `app-shell/views/DashboardConfigPanel.tsx` — **deleted** (orphaned after the above); stale reference in `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` header comment updated.
- Docs: `content/docs/guide/console.md` "Design in Studio" row updated.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor.

## Testing

- **End-to-end against the real HotCRM app** (framework backend + this console dev server): confirmed the dashboard header no longer renders the Edit button, and the Studio icon lands on `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/interfaces?surface=dashboard:executive_dashboard` (the dashboard's design surface, with its properties + widgets + live preview).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` → `appRoute.test.ts` 17 passed (incl. new `appStudioSurfacePath` cases).
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` → all packages build (full `tsc` typecheck green).
